digest.component_or_area: ADR and test infrastructure / Gerrit Verify and External Integration workflows
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently executes thousands of real Pandoc subprocess conversions on the complete DC wiki corpus, consuming at least 184.32 seconds of macOS critical path per run.
ADR 0095 mandates real-Pandoc process execution for every conversion assertion, which blocks moving corpus replay to external integration.
The decision supersedes ADR 0095 only on the test execution boundary, preserving all production renderer invariants, platform checks, safety assertions, and fallback behavior.
Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay will move to a dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay matrix job in external-integration.yml with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners, currently not present.

Gerrit Verify will retain three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) and compact provenance probes, with every assertion class verified against committed deterministic outputs.
Implementation must obtain paired A/B evidence and fail fast on Pandoc version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprint mismatches.
